verdict.rationale: Statsig documents two first-party routes to experiment metrics from your own data. Warehouse Native runs experiment analysis directly in your data warehouse, including on experiments from third-party or internal systems. Custom events logged through the API are explicitly used for metric calculation and measuring experiment outcomes, and those metrics are then chosen in the experiment scorecard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the metric-definition workflow (e.g., defining metrics via SQL or warehouse table/column mapping), and independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse-sourced metric definitions.
